changes.summary: Implemented backend hard delete for pagos, ingresos and gastos.
code: Added sheetsRepository.findById() and repo.delete alias over deleteRow().
Replaced service cancel() exports with remove() in pagos, ingresos and gastos.
DELETE routes keep requireAdmin and no longer validate a body or require motivo.
Added GET /:id routes for pagos, ingresos and gastos so deleted records return a real 404.
changes.audit_behavior: DELETE logs action='delete' with changes.before snapshot and no after/motivo payload.
changes.compatibility: The estado field remains in movement schemas and balance still excludes historical estado='anulado' rows.
